sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Donj Jewellery is a proudly Canadian fine jewelry brand that originated from Laval, Montreal, but has grown soon enough. It is now serving customers across multiple major cities in Canada, including Vancouver, Ottawa, Edmonton, Hamilton, and many more.

Don J is known for ensuring competitive pricing, exceptional craftsmanship, and a personalized approach to jewelry. Moreover, they have successfully built a strong reputation as one of Canada’s most trusted names for selling the best diamond engagement rings and fine jewelry.

And they don’t stop with the diamond rings only, but have a wide range from classic solitaire and halo engagement rings to lab-grown diamond rings, wedding bands, gold chains, custom-designed pieces, and everyday fine jewelry for both men and women.

With a growing online presence and a loyal customer base, team Don J was in dire need of a digital platform that could match the elegance and quality of their jewelry, and that is where they found Dynamic Dreamz.

Team Dynamic Dreamz helped them transform their digital presence by building a customer-centric WordPress website that elegantly showcases their entire collections and makes the ring-buying journey truly memorable.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Despite having an exceptional product range and a strong in-store reputation, their existing website was falling quite short of its brand’s potential. So, their founder approached Dynamic Dreamz with a clear need: a website that could do justice to their craftsmanship and help customers confidently explore and purchase fine jewelry online.

These were the key challenges that have been addressed by Dynamic Dreamz:

  • Outdated Website Design: The existing website was falling short of the visual elegance expected of a luxury fine jewelry brand, because of which they were failing to reflect the quality & craftsmanship of Don J’s products.
  • Poor Product Discovery Experience: Their customers had no intuitive way to browse diamonds by shape, size, or quality, which used to make their ring selection process quite confusing and time-consuming.
  • No Custom Ring Design Flow: There was no such feature that allowed customers to mix and match diamonds with ring settings, and there was limited personalization and reduced engagement.
  • Low Online Traffic & Conversions: Without a strong digital presence or an engaging user experience, the website was literally struggling to attract and convert online visitors into buyers.
  • Lack of Visual Appeal at Checkout: Product pages were not offering real-time previews or customization options, because of which, customers were facing many difficulties in visualizing their dream ring before purchasing.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
After having a thorough look at the challenges, team Dynamic Dreamz stepped up, not just redesigning Don J’s website, but also to help them reimagine it from the ground up. The goal was to build a jewelry eCommerce website that can combine luxury aesthetics with intuitive functionality, that can make every visitor feel like they were walking into an exclusive boutique, and that too from the comfort of their home.

Custom WordPress Website Design & Development

Dynamic Dreamz built a fully custom WordPress website tailored specifically for the fine jewelry and diamond engagement ring industry. The design was now reflecting the elegance, trust, and craftsmanship that Don J is known for, with a clean, sophisticated visual language that lets the jewelry take center stage.

Key capabilities:

  • Luxury-focused custom website design
  • Mobile-responsive and performance-optimized
  • Intuitive navigation across product categories
  • Brand-aligned visual identity and user experience

Dynamic Ring Browsing Experience

One of the most impactful features Dynamic Dreamz introduced is the dynamic browsing experience, a revolutionary way for customers to explore and design their perfect engagement ring online. Customers can browse an extensive collection of diamonds filtered by shape, size, and quality, and pair them with diverse ring settings, including solitaires, halos, and pavé designs.

Key capabilities:

  • Filter diamonds by shape, size, and quality
  • Browse ring settings, solitaire, halo, pavé, and more
  • Seamless customization flow for a personalized experience
  • Real-time design preview before purchase

Real-Time Design Preview

To bring the in-store experience online, Dynamic Dreamz implemented a real-time design preview feature. As customers select their preferred diamond and ring setting, they can instantly see how their custom ring will look, creating an emotional and memorable shopping experience that builds confidence and drives conversions.

Key capabilities:

  • Live visual preview of custom ring combinations
  • Engaging and interactive product pages
  • Reduced purchase hesitation through visual confidence
  • Memorable, personalized shopping journey

Fine Jewelry & Lab Grown Diamond Showcase

Beyond engagement rings, Dynamic Dreamz built a well-structured product showcase for Don J’s entire fine jewelry collection, including lab grown diamond rings, wedding bands, gold chains, necklaces, and more. Each category is presented with clear, high-quality visuals and detailed product information to help customers make informed decisions.

Key capabilities:

  • Dedicated sections for lab grown diamonds and fine jewelry
  • Structured product pages with detailed specifications
  • Clear categorization across rings, chains, necklaces, and more
  • Trust-building elements – warranty info, ethical sourcing highlights

sections.heading: Results & Impact
sections.html:
The redesigned WordPress website was able to provide Don J the powerful digital platform they needed to grow their online presence. Just so they can deliver a truly exceptional customer experience, one that truly reflects the quality and craftsmanship behind every piece of jewelry they create.

Key capabilities:

  • Elevated Brand Presence: The new website positioned Don J as a premium fine jewelry destination online, accurately reflecting the luxury and craftsmanship of their products.
  • Improved Customer Engagement: The dynamic browsing experience and real-time design preview kept visitors engaged longer, making the ring selection process enjoyable and intuitive.
  • Increased Online Traffic: A well-structured, SEO-friendly website helped attract more organic visitors searching for diamond engagement rings and fine jewelry across Canada.
  • Boosted Sales & Conversions: By simplifying the custom ring design journey and building visual confidence at checkout, the platform contributed to a significant uplift in online sales.
  • Stronger Customer Trust: Clear product information, ethical sourcing highlights, warranty details, and an elegant design collectively built greater trust among online shoppers.
  • Scalable Digital Foundation: The custom WordPress platform is built to grow with Don J, supporting new collections, locations, and features as the brand continues to expand across Canada.

From a single founder’s vision to a customer-centric fine jewelry platform, Dynamic Dreamz helped Don J turn their digital presence into one of their greatest assets.

title: Tankbar: Custom Shopify Hongo Theme Store with Smoothie Bundle & Subscription Functionality

archive.title: Fuelling Every Day, One Smoothie at a Time Tankbar
archive.excerpt: Life in Switzerland moves fast. With packed schedules, people have no time to eat right, and healthy nutrition often takes a back seat.

image.alt: Tankbar Shopify Custom Apps & Integrations case study storefront

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Tankbar was born out of a simple but deeply relevant insight: That many people want to eat healthy food, but in this modern lifestyle, it’s difficult to find that. So, the Tankbar comes forth as the answer, a fresh, nutrient-packed smoothie loaded with proteins, superfoods & healthy fats delivered directly to your home or office.

So, whether it’s about fuelling focus during a busy workday or simply to power recovery after training, Tankbar is there to ensure that you get the right nutrition that is always within reach.

Here, customers can order individual smoothies or choose a flexible subscription every 2 or 4 weeks, and it’s fully customisable and cancellable at any time. Their product range includes a Starter Kit and subscription bundles of 20, 28, and 40 smoothies, giving every customer a plan that fits their lifestyle and appetite.

With a growing Swiss customer base and an expanding product range, Tankbar needed a Shopify store that could handle the complexity of their subscription and bundle model while delivering a seamless, premium shopping experience.

Dynamic Dreamz stepped in to build exactly that, a fully custom health food eCommerce website on the Hongo theme, tailored precisely to Tankbar’s vision and requirements.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Tankbar had a compelling product, a clear mission, and a loyal and growing audience. What they needed was a digital storefront sophisticated enough to handle their unique business model without compromising on user experience.

Here are the key challenges that Dynamic Dreamz addressed:

  • Complex subscription and bundle model: Tankbar’s offering goes well beyond a simple add-to-cart experience. With customisable smoothie bundles of 20, 28, and 40 units and recurring subscription options, this smoothie brand Shopify store needed advanced functionality that the standard Shopify setup couldn’t deliver out of the box.
  • Custom bundle functionality: Customers needed the ability to group multiple products together, select their preferred smoothies, and purchase them as a seamless bundle, a highly specific requirement that demanded custom development from the ground up, aka a custom bundle functionality Shopify.
  • Communicating a health-first brand digitally: Tankbar’s brand is built on freshness, simplicity, and nutrition. Every design and UX decision had to reflect those values; the store needed to feel as clean and energising as the product itself.
  • Deep customisation on the Hongo theme: The client’s specific vision required going significantly beyond the Shopify Hongo theme customisation and its default capabilities, demanding extensive custom front-end development and thoughtful UX enhancements throughout.
  • Building trust in the Swiss eCommerce market: Swiss consumers have high standards for digital experiences. The store had to feel premium, professional, and completely reliable to convert health-conscious shoppers into long-term subscribers.

Dynamic Dreamz approached the Tankbar project with a focus on two things above all else: functionality that works flawlessly and a design that earns trust instantly. Every development decision was made in service of Tankbar’s customers and their unique buying journey.

Our development team built the entire Tankbar store on a custom Shopify store Switzerland with the Hongo theme, with deep, bespoke customisation, tailored sections, custom components, and carefully crafted layouts that bring Tankbar’s clean, health-forward identity to life online. The result is a nutrition brand online store that feels uniquely Tankbar, not off-the-shelf.

Key capabilities:

  • Complete custom Hongo theme development well beyond default theme capabilities
  • Clean, health-forward design language aligned with Tankbar’s brand identity
  • Intuitive navigation designed around Tankbar’s subscription and bundle-first product range
  • Fully responsive, mobile-optimised experience for on-the-go Swiss shoppers

Custom Product Bundle Functionality

The standout feature of the Tankbar store is its custom bundle functionality, allowing customers to group multiple smoothie products together and purchase them as one seamless package. This was built entirely from scratch, designed to mirror the flexibility Tankbar offers its customers and make the bundle buying journey as frictionless as possible.

  • Flexible quantity selection across bundle tiers 20, 28, and 40 smoothie options
  • Seamless add-to-cart and checkout flow for bundled products
  • Built to support Tankbar’s subscription model alongside one-time bundle purchases
  • Reduces friction in the purchase journey for high-consideration subscription customers

Subscription-Ready Store Architecture

With recurring orders at the core of Tankbar’s business model, we structured the entire store architecture to support and promote the subscription experience, making it easy for new visitors to understand the offering and for existing customers to manage their plans.

Key capabilities:

  • Clear subscription tier presentation 20, 28, and 40 smoothie plans

  • UX enhancements designed to reduce drop-off and improve subscription conversion

archive.title: Daniel Walters Eyewear – BigCommerce to Shopify Migration & Dawn Theme Redesign
archive.excerpt: Migrating an entire eCommerce store to a new platform is a tough task- and it gets even tougher if it's about the brand having thousands of SKUs throughout the prescription eyewear, sunglasses & designer collections.

image.alt: Daniel Walters Shopify Migration case study storefront

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Daniel Walters Eyewear is a reputable go-to online eyewear retailer that is known for delivering exactly what customers throughout the USA are looking for. They have a wide variety of prescription eyeglasses and sunglasses in almost all the colours, sizes, shapes, and designs imaginable.

Their catalogue spans hand-picked designer and lifestyle brands, including Vivid, Fysh, LAMB, Capri, Superflex Kids, Brooklyn, Ray-Ban, Diesel, Guess, and GANT, alongside their own in-house Daniel Walters eyewear line.

Catering to men, women, and kids nationwide, Daniel Walters makes eyewear genuinely accessible, accepting FSA/HSA dollars and out-of-network vision insurance benefits, offering free shipping across the USA, 30-day free returns, and a 1-year manufacturer’s warranty on every pair.

As the brand scaled, its existing BigCommerce platform could no longer keep pace with its ambitions. Daniel Walters needed a more flexible, scalable, and design-forward foundation to support their growing product range and customer base, and that meant a full migration to Shopify. Dynamic Dreamz stepped in to handle the complete journey, migrating the entire store from BigCommerce to Shopify and redesigning it from scratch on the Dawn theme, fully customised to Daniel Walters’ specific requirements.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Daniel Walters had the brand trust, the product depth, and a loyal customer base across the USA. What they needed was a platform migration and redesign executed with precision without losing a single product, customer record, or ounce of SEO equity along the way.

Here are the key challenges that Dynamic Dreamz addressed:

  • High-stakes platform migration: Migrating an established eCommerce business from BigCommerce to Shopify carries significant risk- products, collections, customer data, order history, and URL structures all need to be transferred accurately, without disrupting the live business or losing existing SEO rankings.
  • Complex multi-brand catalogue: With prescription eyewear and sunglasses spanning ten-plus brands alongside their in-house line, structuring the catalogue for clear navigation across designer brands, budget options, and kids’ eyewear required careful planning during the rebuild.
  • Outdated platform limiting growth: BigCommerce’s limitations were holding the brand back from the design flexibility, app ecosystem, and scalability that Shopify’s Dawn theme could offer, making the migration a strategic, growth-enabling decision rather than just a technical one.
  • Designing a trust-first eyewear experience: Prescription eyewear is a high-consideration purchase. The redesigned store needed to immediately build trust around insurance acceptance, warranty terms, and return policies, while making prescription entry and lens selection intuitive.
  • Zero-disruption cutover: With an active, revenue-generating store, the migration and redesign needed to be executed carefully to avoid downtime, broken links, or any disruption to the customer experience during the transition.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
Dynamic Dreamz approached the Daniel Walters project as a two-part mission execute a flawless BigCommerce to Shopify migration, then rebuild the entire store from the ground up into a faster, more flexible, and beautifully designed online eyewear eCommerce website.

Complete BigCommerce to Shopify Migration

Our team carried out a full, carefully managed migration of the Daniel Walters store from BigCommerce to Shopify, transferring products, collections, customer data, and order history accurately, while preserving SEO equity and avoiding any disruption to the live business.

Key capabilities:

  • Full BigCommerce to Shopify migration covering products, collections, and customer data
  • SEO-conscious migration process to preserve existing search rankings and URL equity
  • Zero-disruption cutover ensuring continuity for an active, revenue-generating store
  • Thorough data validation post-migration to confirm accuracy across the entire catalogue

Complete Store Redesign on the Dawn Theme

With the migration complete, our development team rebuilt the entire Daniel Walters store from scratch on Shopify’s Dawn theme, custom-designed and developed to reflect the brand’s trustworthy, accessible positioning in the prescription eyewear space.

Key capabilities:

  • Full Shopify Dawn theme customisation built entirely from scratch
  • Clean, trust-first design language suited to a high-consideration eyewear purchase journey
  • Structured navigation across designer brands, in-house collections, and budget-friendly options
  • Fully responsive, mobile-optimised experience across all devices

Catalogue Architecture for a Multi-Brand Eyewear Store

With ten-plus stocked brands alongside their own in-house eyewear line, we structured the Daniel Walters catalogue to make discovery effortless, whether a shopper is searching for a specific designer brand, kids’ eyewear, or budget-friendly prescription glasses.

Key capabilities:

  • Clear catalogue architecture spanning designer brands, in-house collections, and kids’ eyewear
  • Intuitive navigation supporting both brand-led and need-led shopping journeys
  • Optimised collection and product pages for prescription eyewear and sunglasses
  • Trust signals around insurance acceptance, warranty, and returns are integrated throughout the journey

archive.title: 80 Years of Comfort, Upgraded for the Digital Age- Aetrex
archive.excerpt: Since 1946, Aetrex has been at the forefront of orthotic footwear and foot scanning technology- it’s a science-based brand built on precision and genuine commitment to foot health.

image.alt: Aetrex Shopify / Shopify Plus case study storefront

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Aetrex, Inc. is not simply a footwear brand, but a global leader in foot health technology with nearly 8 decades of innovation behind it. It was founded back in 1946, and owned by the Schwartz family for 3 generations.

They have a massive product range that spans orthotic sneakers, sandals, boots, and dress shoes, over-the-counter orthotics, 3D custom-printed orthotics & wellness footwear, all engineered to address conditions including Plantar Fasciitis, Arch Pain, Metatarsalgia, and Overpronation. Headquartered in Teaneck, New Jersey, with additional offices in Israel and China, Aetrex employs 200+ people, including hardware and software engineers, footwear designers, and developers.

With a brand this established and a product catalogue this sophisticated, Aetrex needed its Shopify store to reflect the same level of precision and professionalism that defines everything they do. Dynamic Dreamz stepped in to deliver a comprehensive set of Shopify upgrades and enhancements, from version upgrades to product groupings, variant filters to UI improvements, ensuring the store performed as well as the products it sells.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Aetrex had the global reputation, the product depth, and the technology leadership. What their Shopify store needed was a series of targeted, precision upgrades to match the standard of the brand and serve their customers more effectively, just like a Comfort Footwear eCommerce website.

Here are the key challenges that Dynamic Dreamz addressed:

  • Outdated Shopify version holding back performance: Running on an older Shopify version meant Aetrex was missing out on platform improvements, new features, and performance enhancements that could directly benefit their store’s speed and stability.
  • Product variants and filters not aligned with client requirements:  With a wide range of footwear across multiple styles, sizes, widths, and conditions, the existing product variant and filter setup wasn’t structured to meet Aetrex’s specific requirements — making it harder for shoppers to find the right product quickly.
  • Static product cards lacking interactivity: In a competitive footwear eCommerce website development, product cards that don’t respond to user interaction miss a critical opportunity to engage shoppers and surface key information — image, price, and product details at the moment of browsing intent.
  • No product grouping structure: With a catalogue spanning orthotics, wellness footwear, and scanning technology, products needed to be intelligently grouped to support a coherent, intuitive shopping journey rather than an overwhelming flat catalogue.
  • Multiple UI inconsistencies across the site: Accumulated design issues and UI inconsistencies across the storefront were creating a disjointed experience, undermining the premium, authoritative positioning of a brand as established as Aetrex.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
Dynamic Dreamz approached the Aetrex project with surgical precision, identifying every area of improvement and executing each enhancement exactly to the client’s requirements, without disrupting the live store experience.

Shopify Version Upgrade

We carried out a full Shopify version upgrade for the Aetrex store, ensuring the platform was up to date, stable, and equipped with the latest Shopify capabilities. This laid a stronger technical foundation for all subsequent enhancements and ensured the store was running at its best.

Key capabilities:

  • Full Shopify version upgrade executed without disruption to the live store
  • Platform stability and performance improvements were unlocked through the upgrade
  • Compatibility ensured across all existing themes, apps, and custom code
  • Future-ready foundation established for ongoing store development

Product Variants & Filters Setup

We configured and structured product variants and filters precisely as per Aetrex’s requirements, making it significantly easier for shoppers to narrow down options by size, width, style, colour, and condition, and find the right footwear or orthotic solution for their needs.

Key capabilities:

  • Product variants structured and configured to Aetrex’s exact specifications
  • Custom filters set up for intuitive product discovery across footwear categories
  • Filtering by foot condition, style, size, and width to serve health-conscious shoppers
  • Improved browse-to-purchase flow for a catalogue spanning multiple product types

Product Card Hover Functionality

We implemented custom product card hover functionality, allowing shoppers to see updated images, pricing, and key product details the moment they hover over a product card. A small but high-impact enhancement that significantly improves the browsing experience on a footwear eCommerce website.

Key capabilities:

  • Dynamic image update on product card hover showcasing alternate product views
  • Price and product detail updates triggered on hover for faster decision-making
  • An engaging, interactive browsing experience that reduces clicks to product discovery
  • Consistent hover behaviour implemented across all relevant collection pages

Product Groupings

We created intelligent product groupings across the Aetrex catalogue through Shopify product grouping development, organising products into logical, coherent clusters that make it easier for shoppers to discover related styles, complementary orthotics, and complete foot health solutions in one place.

Key capabilities:

  • Product groupings created across footwear styles, orthotic types, and health conditions
  • Supports a coherent, guided shopping journey across a complex, multi-category catalogue
  • Improves cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the Aetrex product range
  • Reduces catalogue overwhelm for shoppers seeking targeted foot health solutions

Design Changes & UI Issue Resolution

We executed multiple design improvements through Shopify UI improvement services and resolved UI inconsistencies across the Aetrex storefront, bringing a higher level of visual consistency, polish, and professionalism to every page, in line with Aetrex’s global brand standards.

Key capabilities:

  • UI inconsistencies identified and resolved across the storefront

  • Elevated overall store aesthetic to match Aetrex’s premium, globally recognised positioning

archive.excerpt: Some brands sell supplements, while Rooted Human sells a science-baked, gentle, self-restoration to women. They want them to have better clarity in the middle of their modern lifestyle.

image.alt: Rooted Human Shopify / Shopify Plus case study storefront

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Rooted Human was built on the vision to help women whose stress is high, hormones are all over the place, and who are living an unbalanced life. They wanted to help those women lighten the burden modern lifestyle puts on them.

Rooted Human, focused on being a science-led wellness supplement brand designed exclusively for women, and they succeed. They ensured to create evidence-based daily rituals that support the rhythms of real life and play a crucial role in restoring calm, improving sleep, and helping women feel grounded again.

You’ll be surprised to know their amazing product range, which includes;

  • Drift Deeper, a non-hormonal sleep capsule combining science-aligned dosages of key botanicals to support deeper, more restorative rest, and
  • Quiet Mind, a botanically rich bedtime gummy featuring Montmorency cherry, 5-HTP, magnesium, and calming herbs to ease the transition into sleep.
  • The results are clear: 92% of users felt calmer and more emotionally balanced after 30 days, 87% reported improved sleep quality, and 81% found it easier to wind down.

With a growing community of women across the UK and a product range built on real results, Rooted Human needed a Shopify store that matched the warmth, precision, and premium quality of their brand.

Dynamic Dreamz stepped in to deliver a fully custom health and wellness eCommerce website UK built on Shopify’s Dawn theme with a clean, responsive design, product bundle functionality, and optimised product displays, tailored precisely to Rooted Human’s vision.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Rooted Human had the science, the brand story, and the products to back it all up. What they needed was a digital storefront thoughtful enough to communicate all of that and functional enough to convert a wellness-conscious audience into loyal, returning customers.

Here are the key challenges that Dynamic Dreamz addressed:

  • Communicating a deeply personal brand digitally: Rooted Human’s brand is built on empathy, science, and a genuine understanding of women’s wellness needs. Translating that warmth and credibility into a digital experience without it feeling clinical or generic required careful design and UX decisions at every turn.
  • Clean, distraction-free design for a considered audience: Rooted Human’s customers are thoughtful, research-led buyers. The store needed a clean, uncluttered aesthetic that let the products and their benefits speak clearly; any visual noise would undermine the brand’s carefully built positioning.
  • Inconsistent experience across devices: With a predominantly mobile audience browsing and buying across multiple devices, the store needed a fully responsive layout that delivered the same premium, seamless experience whether on desktop, tablet, or smartphone.
  • No product bundle functionality: Rooted Human’s wellness ritual model naturally lends itself to bundled purchasing, pairing sleep supplements with complementary products for a complete daily ritual. Without bundle functionality, the store was missing a significant opportunity to increase average order value and deepen customer commitment.
  • Product discovery needed optimisation: With a targeted product range designed for specific wellness needs, shoppers needed to be guided intuitively toward the right product for them, requiring optimised product displays and a discovery experience that felt personal rather than transactional.

sections.heading: Solution

Dynamic Dreamz approached the Rooted Human project with the same care and intentionality that defines the brand itself, building a women’s wellness supplement Shopify store that feels as good to browse as the products feel to use.

Fully Custom Shopify Store on the Dawn Theme

Our development team built the entire Rooted Human store on Shopify’s Dawn theme with deep, bespoke customisation, clean layouts, thoughtful typography, and carefully considered design decisions that bring Rooted Human’s science-meets-nature brand identity to life online. The result is a DTC wellness brand Shopify store that feels premium, purposeful, and uniquely Rooted Human.

Key capabilities:

  • Complete Shopify Dawn theme customisation well beyond default theme capabilities
  • Clean, considered design language aligned with Rooted Human’s women’s wellness brand identity
  • Warm, premium aesthetic that communicates science-backed credibility without feeling clinical
  • Fully tailored layouts across homepage, collection pages, and product detail pages

Responsive Design Across All Devices

Every core page of the Rooted Human store was built with a responsive Shopify store design approach, ensuring that the clean, premium experience translates perfectly across all screen sizes, from desktop to smartphones, where Rooted Human’s audience most frequently shops.

Key capabilities:

  • Fully responsive layout delivering a consistent premium experience across all devices

YHUS bridges that gap with premium composite wood products that deliver the charm of wood and the resilience of composite, manufactured entirely in France to the highest quality standards.

Their product range spans two core categories: fencing and decking. For fencing, YHUS offers fence boards, vertical and horizontal decorative panels, and a full range of accessories, available in five colours: Noir, Sable, Gris clair, Gris anthracite, and Taupe. For decking, their range includes composite decking boards, pine and composite joists, and decking accessories, available in Brun chocolat, Brun clair, Sable, Gris clair, and Gris souris. Free delivery is offered on orders of €1,000 and above.

YHUS’s buying journey is distinctly considered, as customers can book appointments, request quotes, order free samples before committing to a purchase, and access detailed installation guides and maintenance advice. Selling products by the square metre adds another layer of complexity to the purchasing process, requiring a digital experience that could handle technical calculations without friction.

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
E2IP Technologies is a Montreal-based global technology leader specialising in printed electronics, advanced material science, and human-machine interface (HMI) solutions. What began over 40 years ago as a family business in screen printing has evolved through decades of innovation, strategic acquisitions, and relentless R&D into one of the world’s most advanced smart surface and HMI companies, now serving global market leaders across some of the most demanding sectors on the planet.

The company’s core philosophy is elegantly simple: transform the surfaces we touch in everyday life, and simplify how we interact with our physical environment. From the cockpit of an aircraft to the control panel of a medical device, from the dashboard of a connected vehicle to the interface of an industrial machine, E2IP Technologies is the invisible intelligence beneath the surface.

Their five core product lines reflect the full breadth of this ambition:

Smart Structural Surfaces™ Smart Touch Surfaces Membrane Switches 5G Smart Surfaces Edge AI Sensing Kit
In-Mold Electronics Embedded HMI Modules Control Interface Systems Next-Gen Connectivity Real-Time AI Processing

E2IP Technologies serves global market leaders across six key industries — bringing advanced HMI and smart surface solutions to the sectors where precision, reliability, and innovation matter most:

Aerospace Medical Industrial Transportation Telecom Consumer Appliances

With a Crystal Cabin Award for aerospace innovation, a CES 2021 Best of Innovation Honoree distinction for their 5G Smart Surface technology, and $120 million in growth funding secured to accelerate global expansion, E2IP Technologies stands at the forefront of the printed electronics revolution. Their product shop at shop.e2ip.com needed a Shopify store that matched this level of ambition, and Dynamic Dreamz was the partner to build it.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
E2IP Technologies’ product shop serves a highly specialised B2B audience- engineers, OEM buyers, product designers, and procurement teams who approach the purchasing process very differently from a typical eCommerce consumer.

Building a Shopify store that could serve this technical, detail-oriented audience required a deep understanding of the B2B buying journey and a thoughtful approach to both design and functionality.

Key challenges included:

  • Serving a Technical B2B Audience :  E2IP Technologies’ buyers are engineers and procurement professionals who spend significant time researching technical specifications, datasheets, and product documentation before making a purchasing decision. The store needed to support this research-heavy journey while still converting visitors into buyers.
  • Friction in the Purchase Journey: B2B buyers navigating across multiple pages-  product specs, documentation, use cases, and application examples had no quick, persistent access to a purchase option. This created unnecessary friction and potential drop-off at the point of intent.
  • Complex Product Range for a Specialised Market: E2IP Technologies’ product catalogue spanning HMI modules, embedded systems eCommerce website for embedded display systems, development kits, and accessories required a clear, structured product presentation tailored to a technically literate audience who expects precision and detail.
  • Building Credibility in a High-Stakes B2B Context: In the industrial electronics and HMI space, purchasing decisions involve significant investment and technical risk. The store needed to immediately establish E2IP Technologies’ credibility through awards, certifications, and a design that communicates enterprise-grade quality.
  • Balancing Technical Depth with Usability: The store had to deliver enough technical detail to satisfy engineers evaluating products, while remaining intuitive and navigable for procurement teams focused on efficiency rather than specification depth.
  • Custom Theme Requirements Beyond Standard Shopify: E2IP Technologies had a specific vision for how their product shop should look and function, requiring a level of customisation that went well beyond what any off-the-shelf Shopify theme could deliver out of the box.

sections.heading: Solution

archive.title: Elevated ALYVE's Shopify Experience
archive.excerpt: Your vitamins are personalised. So why shouldn't your digital experience be? ALYVE is the UK's No.1 rated personalised vitamin subscription brand, built on science, powered by AI, and trusted by over 100,000 customers.

image.alt: ALYVE Shopify Custom Apps & Integrations case study storefront

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
ALYVE is a UK-based personalised wellness and health tech brand founded in 2019 by Sam Price and Justin Price. Born from Sam’s personal health struggles after being diagnosed with ADD, ALYVE was built on a simple but powerful mission: to cut through the noise, confusion, and expense of the supplement industry and deliver exactly what each person’s body needs, nothing more, nothing less.

At the core of ALYVE’s offering is a free online health quiz powered by AI. Customers answer questions about their lifestyle, health goals, sleep, energy, digestion, and more- and ALYVE’s intelligent algorithm builds a completely unique, all-in-one personalised vitamin formula tailored to their specific needs. Two capsules a day. One powerful, personalised bottle. Delivered every 30 days.

ALYVE ensures a subscription model with which their customers can unlock a full wellness ecosystem. An ecosystem that includes direct access to in-house nutritionists via WhatsApp, 1:1 expert video calls, home-kit blood tests, monthly wellness rewards and gifts & the ability to track health progression directly within the customer’s account.

Every formula here is 100% vegan, gluten-free & made with highly bioavailable, therapeutically dosed ingredients- with no unnecessary binders or fillers.

Today, ALYVE is the UK’s No.1 rated supplement brand on Trustpilot with a rating of 4.7 out of 5 across 1,100+ verified reviews. They serve over 100,000 customers, and are stocked at Boots UK, which, by the way, is one of the country’s most trusted pharmacy chains. The brand has also offset 120,000kg of CO2 through its tree-planting scheme, reflecting a deep commitment to both personal and planetary wellness.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
As ALYVE scaled rapidly, its customer base tended to grow with it, and they started to face some issues with it. Two key pages at the heart of the subscriber experience were no longer keeping pace with the brand’s ambitions: the Quiz Result page & the Account page.

Both kinds of problems required significant upgrades just so they can match ALYVE’s premium positioning & to deliver the personalised, tech-forward experience their customers expected.

Key challenges included:

  • The existing Quiz Result page felt static and generic, failing to communicate the depth of personalisation behind each customer’s unique formula. It didn’t effectively translate quiz data into a compelling, personalised result experience.
  • Results were not being displayed dynamically based on individual quiz completions, meaning every customer saw a similar experience regardless of their unique health profile and goals.
  • The Account page lacked the depth and interactivity needed for a subscription wellness brand. Customers had no easy way to track their health progress, access test results, or get real-time support within the platform.
  • As a brand powered by AI and nutrition expertise, ALYVE needed an intelligent chatbot interface within the Account page to provide instant, personalised guidance and support to subscribers.
  • Without skeleton loaders, certain sections of the Account page experienced noticeable loading delays, creating a jarring, unpolished experience that didn’t match ALYVE’s premium brand standards.
  • Subscribers had no visual way to track how their health metrics were evolving over time, a critical gap for a brand whose entire value proposition is built on personalised, measurable wellness progress.

Pages Enhanced By Dynamic Dreamz

Dynamic Dreamz focused on two pivotal pages within the ALYVE subscriber journey, the Quiz Result page and the Account page. These are the pages where ALYVE’s personalisation promise is most tangible, and where a seamless, modern experience is critical to subscriber satisfaction and retention

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
Dynamic Dreamz approached the ALYVE engagement as a UX and feature enhancement project, focused on making the subscriber experience smarter, faster, more personalised, and more visually compelling across both the Quiz Result page and the Account page.

Quiz Result Page- Complete Redesign

Dynamic Dreamz completely redesigned the ALYVE Quiz Result page from the ground up, transforming it from a static, one-size-fits-all results screen into a modern, dynamic, and deeply personalised experience that reflects the unique formula built for each customer.

Key capabilities:

  • Full visual redesign with a modern, clean, health-tech aesthetic
  • Dynamic result display tailored to each user’s unique quiz responses
  • Personalised formula breakdown, ingredients, goals, and health benefits
  • Clear, conversion-optimised layout guiding users from result to subscription
  • Mobile-responsive design for a seamless experience across all devices

Dynamic Results Based on Quiz Completion

One of the most impactful improvements Dynamic Dreamz implemented is the dynamic result rendering system, ensuring that every customer who completes the ALYVE quiz sees a result page that is genuinely unique to them.

Rather than a generic outcome page, users now see a personalised breakdown of their formula, their specific health goals, and the ingredients selected to address their individual needs.

Key capabilities:

  • Real-time dynamic rendering of quiz results per individual user
  • Goal-specific content display, energy, sleep, immunity, focus, and more
  • Personalised ingredient highlights matched to each user’s health profile
  • Engaging, trust-building result presentation that reinforces ALYVE’s personalisation promise

Dynamic Dreamz integrated a fully functional AI chatbot interface directly into ALYVE’s Account page, bringing intelligent, real-time nutritional guidance and support into the subscriber’s personal wellness hub. This feature transforms the Account page from a static order management screen into an interactive, always-on wellness companion.

Key capabilities:

  • AI-powered chatbot integrated natively within the Account page
  • Instant, personalised responses to nutrition, supplement, and wellness queries
  • Seamless chat interface aligned with ALYVE’s brand design language
  • Reduces reliance on manual customer support for common wellness questions

Account Page- Progression Chart

To bring ALYVE’s health tracking promise to life, Dynamic Dreamz built and integrated a Progression Chart into the Account page, giving subscribers a clear, visual representation of how their health metrics are improving over time. This feature directly reinforces ALYVE’s core value proposition: measurable, personalised wellness progress.

Key capabilities:

  • Visual Progression Chart tracking health data over the subscriber’s journey
  • Clear, intuitive data visualisation accessible directly within the Account page
  • Motivational progress tracking to improve subscriber engagement and retention
  • Data updated in line with test results and wellness milestones

Account Page- Updated Test Results

Dynamic Dreamz enhanced the test results section within the Account page, giving ALYVE subscribers a cleaner, more informative view of their home-kit blood test data and health metrics. The updated design makes it easier for customers to understand their results and take actionable steps towards their wellness goals.

Key capabilities:

  • Redesigned test results display within the Account page
  • Clearer data presentation for home-kit blood test results
  • Easy-to-understand health metric breakdowns
  • Seamlessly connected to the Progression Chart for a holistic health view

Skeleton Loaders for Improved Performance & UX

To eliminate loading delays and deliver a polished, premium feel, Dynamic Dreamz implemented skeleton loaders across key sections of the Account page. Rather than blank white screens or spinning icons during data loading, subscribers now see smooth, branded skeleton placeholders, creating the perception of instant responsiveness and a significantly improved overall user experience.

Key capabilities:

  • Skeleton loaders implemented across the Account page for faster perceived load times
  • Smooth, non-disruptive loading experience that maintains visual consistency
  • Reduced user frustration during data-heavy page loads
  • Professional, app-like performance feels aligned with ALYVE’s health tech positioning

sections.heading: Results & Impact
sections.html:
The enhancements delivered by Dynamic Dreamz across the Quiz Result page and Account page gave ALYVE a significantly more powerful, personalised, and polished subscriber experience, one that better reflects the brand’s health tech ambitions and deepens the connection between ALYVE and its growing community of wellness subscribers.

  • More Impactful Quiz Results: The completely redesigned Quiz Result page now delivers a truly personalised, dynamic result for every user, strengthening ALYVE’s personalisation promise and improving post-quiz conversion rates.
  • Deeper Subscriber Engagement: The AI chatbot interface and Progression Chart gave subscribers more reasons to log into their accounts, increasing platform stickiness and ongoing engagement with the ALYVE wellness ecosystem.
  • Smarter Health Tracking: The Progression Chart and updated test results gave subscribers a clear, motivating view of their health journey, reinforcing the value of their ALYVE subscription and supporting long-term retention.
  • Better Performance & Usability: Skeleton loaders eliminated loading friction across the Account page, delivering a faster, smoother, more app-like experience that reflects ALYVE’s premium, health tech brand positioning.
  • Reduced Customer Support Load: The AI chatbot interface within the Account page empowered subscribers to get instant, intelligent answers to their wellness questions, reducing pressure on ALYVE’s human support team.
  • Scalable Personalisation Infrastructure: The dynamic quiz result system and enhanced Account features are built to scale, supporting ALYVE’s growing customer base and evolving wellness platform as the brand continues its rapid UK and global expansion.

Your health is personal. Your digital experience should be too.

sections.heading: About

Santosh Jewellers is a fine & luxury jewellery brand which was established in 1976, and it’s based in New Delhi. They ensured to have the finest quality jewellery at their stores, which was absolutely value for money.

And even today, five decades and three generations later, their principles for doing business, and the quality of the jewellery, remain the same. sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Essential Whitening is a professional-grade teeth whitening brand based in Denver, Colorado. This professional teeth whitening brand wants to keep delivering exceptional whitening results by keeping the sensitivity to a minimum.

Their advanced system is trusted by hundreds of dental professionals across the USA and loved by patients who are in need of professional-grade results, both in-office and at home.

At the heart of the Essential Whitening system is a unique combination of a high-pH gel with Potassium Nitrate and dual LED technology, blue light for accelerated whitening and red light for gum health and sensitivity reduction. Their universal LED tray fits 95% of patients instantly, with no impressions, fittings, or lab work required, making it one of the most accessible and efficient whitening systems on the market.

Their product range includes three core offerings: the Chairside Kit for in-office dental treatments, the Take-Home Kit for patient use, and the Refill Kit for ongoing maintenance. Having invested over $100,000 in research and development, Essential Whitening is committed to delivering up to 6 shades of improvement in a single session, safely, comfortably, and consistently.

With a dual-audience business model serving both B2B dental professionals and direct-to-consumer patients, Essential Whitening needed a dental whitening Shopify store sophisticated enough to serve both worlds, and that’s exactly what Dynamic Dreamz delivered.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Essential Whitening’s existing website was not keeping pace with the brand’s growing reputation and dual-audience business model. Serving both dental professionals purchasing in bulk and individual patients browsing for personal use created a unique set of digital challenges that required a highly customised solution.

Key challenges included:

  • Dual-Audience Complexity: The professional teeth whitening eCommerce website needed to serve two very distinct user groups: dental professionals requiring B2B pricing, bulk ordering, and account-based access, and patients seeking a clean, trustworthy, consumer-friendly shopping experience.
  • Outdated Design Lacking Credibility: The existing website did not reflect the professional, clinical credibility expected of a
    dental-grade whitening brand, making it harder to earn the trust of dental professionals and patients alike.
  • No Quantity-Based Pricing Logic: Dental professionals ordering in bulk had no structured pricing tiers, making the purchasing process cumbersome and inefficient for high-volume buyers.
  • Hidden Pricing for Professionals: There was no account-based visibility system to show exclusive professional pricing only to verified dental professionals, a critical requirement for a B2B dental eCommerce model.
  • Poor Mobile & Cross-Device Experience: The existing store lacked responsive optimisation, creating inconsistent and frustrating experiences for users on mobile and tablet devices.
  • Low Trust & Conversion Rate: Without a credible, well-structured design and clear user journeys for both audiences, the website struggled to convert visitors into buyers, whether professional or patient.

Our Approach to tackle these challenges was a Two-Phase Process

We approached the Essential Whitening project with a detailed, structured, two-phase methodology, just so we could ensure every design and development decision was intentional, brand-aligned, and built to perform.

PHASE 1- Design

In phase one, we focused on custom mockups, which were crafted for both desktop & mobile experiences. In this phase, we ensured a modern, credible, and brand-aligned visual direction before a single line of code was written.

PHASE 2- Development

And in phase 2, we have built a custom Shopify 2.0 theme with quantity-based pricing tiers, hidden professional pricing & full responsiveness across all devices.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
Dynamic Dreamz redesigned and rebuilt the Essential Whitening website from the ground up on Shopify 2.0, delivering a custom-built, conversion-focused store that elegantly serves both dental professionals and patients without compromise.

1. Custom Shopify 2.0 Theme Development

Dynamic Dreamz built a fully custom Shopify 2.0 theme tailored specifically for Essential Whitening’s brand identity and dual-audience requirements. Moving beyond off-the-shelf themes, the custom build ensured complete control over design, functionality, and performance, resulting in a store that looks and works exactly as the brand needs.

Key capabilities:

  • Fully custom Shopify 2.0 theme built from the ground up
  • Modern, clean, clinical aesthetic aligned with a dental-grade brand
  • Flexible section-based architecture for easy future updates
  • Optimised page speed and performance across all devices

2. Custom Desktop & Mobile Design Mockups

Before development began, Dynamic Dreamz created detailed custom mockups for both desktop and mobile experiences. This design-first approach ensured that every layout decision, from homepage hero to product pages, was validated and aligned with Essential Whitening’s brand direction before a single line of code was written.

Key capabilities:

  • High-fidelity desktop and mobile mockups
  • Conversion-focused layout with clear calls to action
  • Separate user journey designs for dental professionals and patients
  • Modern, trustworthy visual identity reflecting clinical credibility

3. Quantity-Based Pricing Logic

One of the most technically significant features Dynamic Dreamz built is the quantity-based pricing system, a critical requirement for Essential Whitening’s B2B dental professional customers who purchase products in bulk. The system automatically applies tiered pricing based on order quantity, making bulk purchasing seamless and incentivised.

Key capabilities:

  • Automated pricing tiers- 5+, 10+, and 20+ unit thresholds
  • Real-time price updates as quantity is adjusted
  • Clear pricing display to encourage higher-volume orders
  • Scalable logic to accommodate additional tiers in the future

4. Hidden Pricing & Account-Based Visibility for Dental Professionals

To protect B2B pricing integrity and create a professional-grade purchasing experience, Dynamic Dreamz implemented a hidden pricing and account-based visibility system. Dental professionals must log in to a verified account to access professional pricing, keeping trade prices confidential from general consumers while offering dental buyers a tailored, exclusive experience.

Key capabilities:

  • Professional pricing is hidden from non-logged-in users
  • Account-based login to unlock dental professional pricing
  • Seamless toggle between consumer and professional product views
  • Secure, role-based access control for B2B pricing visibility

5. Fully Responsive Cross-Device Optimisation

Dynamic Dreamz ensured the redesigned Essential Whitening store delivers a flawless, consistent experience across every device, whether a dental professional is placing a bulk order on a desktop or a patient is browsing products on their phone. Every section, interaction, and checkout flow was meticulously optimised for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Key capabilities:

  • Fully responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • Touch-optimised navigation and product browsing for mobile users
  • Consistent brand experience regardless of screen size
  • Fast-loading, performance-optimised pages across all devices

6. Dual-Audience User Experience Design

Perhaps the most distinctive aspect of the Essential Whitening redesign is how Dynamic Dreamz designed a single website that serves two completely different audiences, dental professionals and patients, without creating confusion or friction for either. Each user group is guided through a clear, intuitive journey tailored to their specific needs.

Key capabilities:

  • Dedicated navigation pathways for professionals and patients
  • Clear product differentiation- Chairside Kit, Take-Home Kit, Refill Kit
  • Trust-building content- clinical credentials, ADA alignment, R&D investment
  • Conversion-optimised flows for both B2B bulk purchasing and D2C patient orders

sections.heading: Results & Impact
sections.html:
The redesigned Essential Whitening Shopify 2.0 store delivered a powerful digital platform that serves both dental professionals and patients with equal confidence, building trust, simplifying purchasing, and setting the brand up for scalable, long-term growth.

  • Enhanced Brand Credibility: The modern, clinically-aligned design immediately communicates professionalism and trust- making it easier for both dental professionals and patients to confidently choose Essential Whitening.
  • Streamlined B2B Purchasing: Quantity-based pricing tiers made bulk ordering straightforward and incentivised for dental professionals, reducing friction and encouraging higher-volume purchases
  • Secure Professional Experience: Account-based pricing visibility ensured dental professionals have access to exclusive trade pricing, while maintaining pricing integrity for the consumer-facing store.
  • Improved Mobile Experience: Full cross-device responsiveness ensured patients and professionals browsing on mobile and tablet enjoy the same seamless, premium experience as desktop users.
  • Higher Engagement & Conversions: A conversion-focused layout, clear user journeys, and trust-building design elements worked together to improve visitor engagement and drive higher conversion rates across both audiences.
  • Scalable Digital Foundation: Built on Shopify 2.0 with a custom theme architecture, the store is fully equipped to scale, supporting new products, pricing tiers, and audience segments as Essential Whitening continues to grow.

“A website that works as hard as your product, built for the professionals who trust it and the patients who love it.”

Dynamic Dreamz x Essential Whitening, Turning a dual-audience challenge into a seamless digital experience on Shopify 2.0.

title: Decor That Shows Up, Does Its Job, and Disappears- Evrgreen
summary: Migrating an entire eCommerce store to a new platform is a tough task- and it gets even tougher if it’s about the brand having thousands of SKUs throughout the prescription eyewear, sunglasses & designer collections.

archive.title: Decor That Shows Up, Does Its Job, and Disappears- Evrgreen
archive.excerpt: Migrating an entire eCommerce store to a new platform is a tough task- and it gets even tougher if it's about the brand having thousands of SKUs throughout the prescription eyewear, sunglasses & designer collections.

image.alt: Evrgreen Shopify / Shopify Plus case study storefront

sections.heading: About
sections.html:
Evrgreen was born out of a simple but brilliant insight: seasonal decorating brings joy, but everything around it doesn’t. The shopping, the storage, the annual unpacking of boxes that take up half the garage, and the eventual disposal of décor that’s gone out of style. Evrgreen eliminates all of it.

The concept is elegantly simple: customers choose a curated décor box Small (5 items, from $59), Medium (8 items, from $89), or Large (12 items, from $109) select their seasonal theme, and have it delivered straight to their door. When the season ends, they return it. Rent, Rejoice, Repeat.

Evrgreen’s seasonal catalogue spans Halloween, Christmas, 4th of July, New Year, Fall and Thanksgiving, and Summer with curated event collections, a fully custom Build-Your-Box flow, monthly subscription options, 20-day and 40-day rental durations, short-term rental solutions for events, and B2B services for businesses that want their spaces seasonally styled without the overhead.

It’s a genuinely innovative business model and one that Shopify, out of the box, was never designed to support. Building a seasonal décor rental platform with a persistent box builder, event-based collections, fixed pricing logic, subscription management, inventory tracking, rental account visibility, and admin lifecycle management required an entirely custom-engineered solution. Dynamic Dreamz built it from the ground up.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Evrgreen had a disruptive idea, a clear audience, and a brand full of warmth and personality. What they needed was a technical foundation sophisticated enough to power a rental and subscription business on a platform that doesn’t natively support either.

Here are the key challenges that Dynamic Dreamz addressed:

  • Shopify doesn’t natively support rental models: Shopify is built for standard eCommerce products that are sold, not rented. Building a fully functional rental solution on Shopify required engineering bespoke systems from scratch, with no off-the-shelf solution available.
  • Event-based shopping with cross-collection flexibility: Customers needed to shop by event Halloween, Christmas, 4th of July, New Year while also being able to freely mix items from multiple event collections into a single rental box. The standard Shopify collection architecture doesn’t support this kind of cross-collection, persistent-cart behaviour.
  • Persistent box state across the entire site: The active box configuration, box type, rental duration, and start and end dates needed to persist across every page of the site until checkout or reset, regardless of which collections or pages the customer visited. This required a custom application layer to manage and maintain.
  • Fixed box pricing with dynamic discounting: Evrgreen’s pricing model is fixed per box tier, not per item. No matter which individual products a customer adds to their box, the final total always equals the fixed box price. Engineering dynamic, per-product discounting that automatically adjusts behind the scenes to maintain this fixed total was a significant technical challenge.
  • Global pricing transparency throughout the journey: Customers needed to see a persistent, real-time summary of their box price, the total value of added products, and the adjusted final price at all times in the header or a sticky component throughout their entire browsing session.
  • Accurate rental inventory tracking: Unlike standard eCommerce where inventory simply depletes on sale, Evrgreen’s rental model requires per-SKU inventory deduction for active rentals and accurate return-date management, a significantly more complex inventory challenge.
  • Rental tracking and return visibility in My Account: Customers needed to see their active rental boxes, rental start and end dates, and a clearly highlighted return date directly within their account, reducing late returns and support tickets.
  • Subscription management complexity: Evrgreen’s monthly subscription model required a custom-built system capable of handling sign-ups, plan management, tier changes, pauses, cancellations, and renewals, with customers able to select new products each month before the order generates, and a default product fallback for those who don’t.
  • One-time vs subscription flexibility: Customers needed the ability to choose between a one-time rental box or a recurring monthly subscription at the point of purchase, with subscription billing applying only to the box price and any extra items charged as separate one-time purchases.
  • Custom admin dashboard for full lifecycle control: Managing active rentals, subscription billing cycles, box tier configuration, default product settings, and subscriber status across a growing customer base required a purpose-built admin dashboard that Shopify’s native admin simply couldn’t provide.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
Dynamic Dreamz approached the Evrgreen project as a platform engineering challenge, designing and building an entirely custom Shopify application layer that powered every aspect of the rental and subscription experience, alongside a beautifully customised Stretch theme storefront that made it all feel effortless.

Shop by Event Collections

We built dedicated Shopify collections for each of Evrgreen’s seasonal events: Halloween, Christmas, 4th of July, New Year, Fall and Thanksgiving, and Summer surfaced as featured tiles on the homepage for immediate, intuitive discovery. Each event collection supports both individual item rentals and a pre-curated “Buy as Bundle” event box option.

Key capabilities:

  • Dedicated event collections for every seasonal theme in Evrgreen’s catalogue
  • Featured event tiles on the homepage for fast, visual seasonal navigation
  • Individual item rental and pre-curated bundle box options within each event collection
  • Clean collection architecture designed for a rental-first browsing experience

Build-Your-Box Flow

We built a globally accessible Build-Your-Box entry point available in the header, sticky sidebar, and as a floating CTA, giving customers the freedom to start building their rental box from any page on the site. A dedicated Box Options page lets customers select their box type, rental duration (20 or 40 days), and start date, with the end date automatically calculated.

Key capabilities:

  • Global “Build Your Box” entry point accessible from header, sticky sidebar, and floating CTA
  • Dedicated Box Options page for box type, rental duration, and start date selection
  • Automatic end date calculation based on selected rental duration
  • Seamless entry into the cross-collection item adding flow from the box builder

Persistent Box State Across the Site

Once a customer starts building their box, the active configuration box type, rental duration, start and end dates persist across the entire Evrgreen site until checkout or reset. Customers can browse multiple event collections, navigate freely across pages, and continue adding items to the same active box without ever losing their selections.

Key capabilities:

  • Custom application layer maintaining persistent box state site-wide
  • Box configuration type, duration, and dates preserved across all pages and collections
  • Customers can mix items from multiple event collections into a single rental box
  • Box resets cleanly at checkout or on manual reset, with no residual state issues

Fixed Box Pricing with Dynamic Discounting

Evrgreen’s pricing model is fixed per box tier regardless of which items a customer selects; the final checkout total always matches the fixed box price. We engineered a dynamic, per-product discounting system that calculates and applies automatic discounts behind the scenes at the cart and checkout level, so the pricing always adds up correctly no matter what the customer puts in their box.

Key capabilities:

  • Dynamic per-product discounting calculated automatically at cart and checkout level
  • Fixed box price maintained regardless of individual item selection or total item value
  • Pricing confidence for customers: no surprises at checkout
  • Discount logic applied cleanly without exposing complexity to the customer-facing experience

Global Pricing Transparency

To keep customers fully informed throughout their browsing and building journey, we implemented a persistent global pricing summary visible in the header or as a sticky component showing the base box price, total value of added products, and the adjusted final box price at all times.

Key capabilities:

  • Persistent global pricing summary visible throughout the entire site session
  • Real-time display of base box price, added item value, and adjusted final total
  • Builds pricing confidence and reduces checkout abandonment
  • Seamlessly integrated into the header and sticky component without disrupting the browsing experience

Rental Tracking in My Account

To reduce late returns and improve the post-purchase experience, we built a dedicated rental tracking view within the Evrgreen customer account, giving customers clear visibility of their active rental boxes, rental start and end dates, and a visually highlighted return date on every order detail page.

Key capabilities:

  • Active rental box status visible directly in My Account
  • Rental start and end dates displayed clearly on every active rental order
  • Visually highlighted return date reducing late-return support tickets
  • Seamless integration with the existing Shopify customer account experience

Orders and Inventory Management

We engineered accurate per-SKU inventory deduction for every rental order, ensuring that Evrgreen’s rental stock levels remain reliable across all concurrent active boxes, with standard Shopify orders created containing both the box product and each individual rental item.

Key capabilities:

  • Per-SKU inventory deduction on every rental order for accurate stock control
  • Standard Shopify orders containing box product and individual rental items
  • Reliable inventory visibility across all concurrent active rental boxes
  • Inventory management designed to scale with Evrgreen’s growing catalogue and customer base

Bespoke Subscription Management Syste

We built a complete custom subscription layer on top of the existing rental flow, giving customers the choice between a one-time rental box or a recurring monthly subscription at the point of purchase. Subscription billing applies to the box price only, with any extra items added as separate one-time purchases.

Key capabilities:

  • Custom subscription management system handling sign-ups, tier changes, pauses, and cancellations
  • One-time vs monthly subscription choice presented clearly at product level
  • Subscription billing applied to box price; only extra items charged as one-time purchases
  • Three subscription tiers: Small, Medium, and Large, each with admin-configurable pricing and item quantities
  • Monthly product selection flow allowing customers to choose new items before each order generates
  • Default product fallback automatically applied for customers who don’t make a monthly selection
  • Full customer self-service in My Account view, edit, cancel, and track upcoming subscription orders

Custom Admin Dashboard for Full Lifecycle Control

To give the Evrgreen team complete visibility and control over their rental and subscription business, we built a fully custom admin dashboard, a single command centre for managing every aspect of the subscription lifecycle, event configuration, and product settings.

Key capabilities:

  • Full subscription lifecycle management: active subscribers, billing cycles, and renewal status
  • Box tier configuration: admin can adjust pricing and item quantities for Small, Medium, and Large tiers at any time
  • Default product settings per subscription tier for the monthly fallback flow
  • Subscription status monitoring across the entire customer base
  • Event and product configuration for ongoing catalogue management

Custom Storefront on the Stretch 1.4.1 Theme

Beyond the back-end engineering, we built a beautifully customised storefront on the Stretch 1.4.1 theme, warm, joyful, and effortlessly on-brand, designed to communicate Evrgreen’s promise of stress-free seasonal decorating from the very first scroll.

Key capabilities:

  • Complete Shopify Stretch theme customisation aligned with Evrgreen’s warm, playful brand identity
  • Clean, intuitive navigation across seasonal event collections, box tiers, and subscription options
  • Fully responsive design delivering a seamless experience across all devices
  • Brand-forward design that communicates joy, simplicity, and the effortlessness of the Evrgreen model

Founded in France and printing every order in their own French ateliers, Tipii’ has built a reputation for quality, warmth, and genuine care. Every product from a square photo album to a vintage magnet is produced with meticulous attention to detail, using premium materials and processes that honour the memories they carry.

Tipii is certified by the Forestry Club de France, replanting 200% of their carbon footprint, and rewards their loyal community with a points-based programme redeemable across every product in the range.

Their catalogue is wonderfully rich — photo albums in portrait, landscape, square, rigid, and soft cover formats, classic and vintage photo prints, photo magnets in square, heart, retro, and photo booth formats, personalised photo calendars, wall décor including feather frames and memory posters, postcards for every occasion, destination-specific travel albums organised by continent and country, love albums, birth announcements, and e-gift cards.

Available in French, Spanish, and English, Tipii’ ships across 20+ European countries — bringing the joy of printed memories to customers from France to Finland.

With a catalogue this diverse and a customer experience this personal, Tipii’ needed a Shopify store that could handle advanced product customisation, guide shoppers intuitively through a wide range of personalised products, and deliver a performance-optimised experience that felt as effortless as the brand itself. sections.heading: Challenges

  • Complex product personalisation requirements: Tipii’s entire product range is built around personalisation; customers upload their own photos and customise formats, sizes, covers, and finishes across dozens of product types.   • Wide and diverse product catalogue: With photo albums, prints, magnets, calendars, wall décor, postcards, travel albums, love albums, and birth announcements all under one roof, structuring the catalogue for intuitive discovery without overwhelming shoppers was a significant UX challenge.

Building a flexible custom product options system that worked seamlessly across the entire catalogue demanded a thoughtful, scalable approach.
  • Performance and speed expectations: A photo-heavy, personalisation-driven eCommerce store carries an inherent risk of slow load times, particularly on mobile. Tipii’s audience expects a fast, fluid experience, and any friction in the browsing or customisation journey risks lost conversions.
  • Tailored page layouts across multiple product types: A photo album product page has very different UX requirements from a postcard or a wall frame. Each product category needed its own tailored layout, one that communicated the product’s unique value and guided the shopper through the personalisation process naturally.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
Bringing unmatched tailoring into a digital environment is never straightforward. Bombay Shirt Company’s biggest challenge was translating a highly personal, in-store experience into an online journey without losing accuracy, clarity, or confidence.

Custom-made shirts involve more than just selecting a size. Customers needed a way to define their body type, adjust measurements precisely & visualize their choices, all within an ecommerce flow that remained simple and intuitive. sections.heading: Challenges

Order fulfillment optimization was required, as customers frequently face delays and high shipping costs due to international shipping from India. Prioritizing local warehouses for order fulfillment whenever inventory was available provided quicker delivery and lower shipping costs before sourcing from international vendors.

Improvement was needed in the vendor onboarding process, inventory synchronization, and order management. A smooth solution was needed to improve working efficiency and accuracy because the current manual workflow was prone to mistakes and delays.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:

With Unicommerce integration, we connected all 300+ vendors to enable real-time inventory updates on Shopify. This automated system confirmed that stock availability was always accurate and prevented overselling and order cancellations, finally enhancing the customer buying experience.

We created a custom rule-based fulfillment system to prioritize local warehouses when stock was available. If the stock was in a local warehouse, such as in the USA, UK, or Australia, the order was fulfilled locally, so it reduced both shipping time and prices. If stock was not available at the local warehouses, the system automatically sent the order to an international vendor, ensuring smooth order processing.

title: Furnified: Shopify Plus B2B Commerce System with Custom ERP Middleware Integration
summary: Two interconnected Shopify Plus B2B storefronts (Verdon Retail and Furnified) built for a Belgium/Netherlands furniture and home decor business, combining Shopify Plus’s native B2B capabilities with a custom middleware integration connecting Shopify to the Exact and Picqer ERP/warehouse systems.

archive.excerpt: Furnified partnered with Dynamic Dreamz to build a robust Shopify Plus ecommerce solution by a Shopify Plus partner agency, with the capability of serving both retail and B2B customers efficiently.

image.alt: Furnified Shopify Custom Apps & Integrations case study storefront

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.html:
While building a scalable B2B ecommerce system, there were several technical and operational challenges that, as a Shopify development agency India, we had to overcome. The platform really needed to support multiple companies with different purchasing structures, and that too, while ensuring a seamless experience for both retail and business buyers.

Here, one of the primary challenges was configuring Shopify Plus to handle company-specific product catalogs, pricing models, and payment terms, and that too, without creating unnecessary operational complexity. Because each B2B company requires unique access rules, multiple users, and predefined shipping destinations.

Another major challenge here was about synchronizing data between Shopify & the client’s ERP systems, Exact and Picqer. Products, inventory, orders, and customer information needed to flow seamlessly between platforms while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

Here, managing inventory visibility and delivery timelines is also quite crucial and will require careful planning. Many products were imported from China, which meant fluctuating lead times. The system really needed to dynamically communicate accurate delivery estimates to customers, so any kind of confusion can be avoided, and support inquiries can be kept to a minimum.

And finally, eliminating manual order processing and data entry was critical, because you know, without automation, the growing number of transactions could quickly lead to operational bottlenecks and data inconsistencies.

sections.heading: Solution
sections.html:
To address these challenges, Dynamic Dreamz implemented a comprehensive Shopify Plus B2B solution supported by a custom-built middleware system that connects Shopify with the client’s ERP platforms.

The project leveraged Shopify Plus’ native B2B capabilities to configure multiple product catalogs with company-specific pricing and purchasing terms. Each B2B company was assigned dedicated catalogs and payment conditions, allowing business customers to access the products and pricing relevant to them.

Customer roles and permissions were also structured carefully. Multiple users could be associated with a single company account, with “order-only” roles enabling buyers to place orders while maintaining centralized company management.

To streamline logistics, a multi-location setup was implemented, allowing companies to maintain multiple default shipping addresses. These locations automatically appeared during checkout, simplifying the ordering process for B2B customers.

A critical part of the solution was the development of a custom middleware integration connecting Shopify with the Exact and Picqer ERP systems. This middleware automated key operational processes, including product synchronization, order creation, customer record management, and inventory updates.

The system also enabled real-time delivery timeline communication. By analyzing ERP stock levels and open purchase orders, the middleware dynamically calculated expected delivery dates and pushed this information to Shopify using metafields. If delays occurred, such as manufacturing or shipping issues from overseas suppliers, the system automatically updated delivery timelines and notified customers.

Together, these systems created a unified commerce environment where Shopify handled the storefront experience while ERP systems managed operational logic in the background.
